introHtml: Relaxed fit pants and shorts give your team room to move without sacrificing a professional look. Whether you need uniform bottoms for warehouse staff or casual apparel for a company picnic, the relaxed cut offers extra comfort through the seat and thigh. Choose from sweatpants, jogger shorts, or scrub pants in durable cotton blends. Add your logo with screen printing or embroidery for a cohesive brand presence that employees actually want to wear.
